row.proto: void Game_SlowMoController_ActivateEntry(void *ctrl, int32_t index, uint8_t flag, uint32_t value)
row.notes: Takes entry = ctrl[+0xa8+index*8], locks the SRW lock at manager(+0x98)+0x270, djb2-hashes the entry name (+0x18) and, if that hash exists in the manager table (+0x60, stride 0x28, count +0x24), makes it current: clears +0x45 on the old current (+0xa0), sets +0x45=1, +0x46=flag, +0x44=0, timer +0x34=0 (or 1.0 when duration +0x3c is under 0.001), +0x38=+0x3c, +0x48=value, pushes it on the 4-deep stack at +0xe0 (count +0x100) and calls Game_TodData_SetScenario_Thunk(manager+8, hash, empty, 0). Named after its terminal-damage slow-mo and instant-replay callers; the exact controller class is not confirmed.
